DigiSophie DSP
https://github.com/soejrd/digisophie
Revision: 11d2364f3ea8faabd21bb9942fdc0a79606b4e1a

MIT-licensed Sophie metallic percussion by Matt Estela and the DigiSophie
contributors. Only sophie.c (renamed sophie.cpp for source discovery),
sophie.h and its generated sine table are compiled. No Digitakt firmware,
adapter, samples or GPL digihealth diagnostics are included.

Tracker adapts the 48 kHz core to the output rate in DrumSynthVoice, sharing
the existing voice pool and filter/VCA path with Bogie. The core is unmodified.
LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md retain upstream attribution.
